Description:

SCOPE OF WORK

The City of North Miami, Florida, hereinafter referred to as “City”, is hereby soliciting bids from qualified, licensed and experienced contractors to provide the necessary supervision, labor and materials for the proposed stormwater drainage improvement project located along N.E. 3rd Court, between N.E. 131st Street and N.E. 135th Street.

DEADLINE FOR ADDITIONAL INFORMATION & CLARIFICATION

Friday, May 8, 2026, by no later no 3:30PM (EST)

DEADLINE FOR SUBMITTAL OF BIDS

Monday, June 8, 2026, by no later no 3:30PM (EST)

Thursday, June 25, 2026, by no later no 3:30PM (EST)

Monday, July 20, 2026, by no later no 3:30PM (EST)

Friday, July 31, 2026, by no later no 3:30PM (EST)
Publication Date/Time:
4/23/2026 12:00 AM
Closing Date/Time:
Open Until Contracted
Submittal Information:
Bids must be submitted to the Office of the City Clerk
